services.title: Roof Replacement
services.short_description: When repair isn't enough, we replace your roof the right way — with the materials, certifications, and warranties to back it up.
services.long_description: Roofs don't last forever. No matter how well your house was built, storms, trees, and debris shorten a roof's life well below its full 25-year expectancy. In most cases repair is enough; when it no longer is, it's time for a replacement. Our GAF Master Elite® President's Club status means you qualify for warranty coverage most roofers simply cannot offer. We handle the project start to finish, so you don't have to manage a thing.

faqs.q: How can I tell if my roof needs replacing rather than repairing?
faqs.a: Visible deterioration, neighbors on the same build cycle replacing theirs, repair costs approaching replacement cost, or a roof over 25 years old are all red flags. Have a professional inspect it before you commit — the last thing you want is to replace a roof that didn't need it.

services.title: Roof Repair
services.short_description: Leaks, missing shingles, or localized damage — diagnosed and fixed fast, without upselling you on work you don't need.
services.long_description: Roof repair is a service most homeowners would rather not think about, but it is critical to the health of the house — and in Texas, extreme weather compromises that health constantly. Whether it's repairing sheathing or installing new shingles, routine repair maintains the integrity of your roof so your home stays protected. Not every problem needs a full replacement. Our repair specialists focus on quality, professionalism, and an honest diagnosis.

faqs.q: What does a typical roof inspection involve?
faqs.a: A routine inspection covers shingle condition, flashing integrity, and gutter function, and identifies any visible signs of damage or wear.

services.title: Storm Damage & Insurance Claims
services.short_description: Hail and wind damage isn't always visible from the ground. We inspect free, then work directly with your adjuster so you get what your policy covers.
services.long_description: Your roof is your home's first line of defense against hail, torrential rain, high winds, scorching sun, and extreme cold. Some storm damage is obvious; most of it requires a closer look, and undetected damage gets expensive fast. One of the reasons we started Results Roofing was watching homeowners get bogged down in insurance jargon with nobody in their corner. We step in and handle the paperwork, do a comprehensive inspection, and are present with your insurance adjuster — our technicians routinely catch damage the insurance teams miss. When a storm causes sudden, serious damage, we also respond on an emergency basis to protect your home immediately while a permanent solution is planned.
sub_services: Insurance claim documentation and adjuster meetings

faqs.q: What are the common signs of storm damage homeowners should look for?
faqs.a: Cracked or missing shingles, dents on metal surfaces, water stains on ceilings, and granule buildup in gutters. Also watch for damage with no discernible pattern, black hail hits, dents that feel soft or bruised to the touch, and debris under multiple shingles.

faqs.q: What happens if I ignore hail damage?
faqs.a: Neglecting hail damage repairs can lead to compromised structural integrity, leaks, and further deterioration — which usually means a much larger bill later. It can also close your window to file an insurance claim.

services.title: New Roof Installation
services.short_description: Building new or starting fresh? We install roofs rated for the Texas climate, every one backed by a GAF warranty.
services.long_description: Homeowners often overlook the roof on a new build, but it is what turns a house into a home — it keeps your family safe from the elements. The roofs we build are more energy-efficient, more durable, and longer-lasting than the industry standard. Every installation includes a free estimate, inspections before and after, licensed and insured crews, and a warranty you can actually use. A more efficient roof saves you money on utilities and reduces your carbon footprint at the same time.

services.title: Roof Maintenance
services.short_description: The cheapest way to avoid a replacement is catching small problems early. One inspection a year can save you thousands.
services.long_description: Your roof is the part of your house you don't think about until something goes wrong — and the most serious damage sneaks in over time. Built-up leaves, untreated branches, and debris shake shingles loose and weaken the structure. Seasonal storms and scorching summers make regular maintenance essential in Texas, but there is far more to a healthy roof than checking after a storm: moss and mold need to be handled before they spread, chimneys and skylights and vents need clearing, and gutters, soffits, downspouts, and fascia need to stay free of blockages. Our maintenance program keeps your roof in shape year-round and extends its lifespan.

faqs.q: How does regular maintenance prolong the life of my roof?
faqs.a: Cleaning gutters, trimming overhanging branches, inspecting for shingle damage, and addressing minor issues promptly all extend your roof's lifespan. The general rule is a good look every spring.

team_members.name: Dustin Gutkowski
team_members.bio: Dustin started from humble beginnings in Austin, moved to Dallas, and ran multiple locations in the fitness industry before founding Results Roofing. After dealing with contractors that were less than ethical, he decided to build the roofing company he wished he'd hired.

faqs.q: What are the potential consequences of neglecting hail damage repairs?
faqs.a: Neglecting hail damage repairs can lead to compromised structural integrity, leaks, and further deterioration of your roof, potentially increasing repair costs in the long run.

faqs.q: What are the common signs of storm damage that homeowners should look out for?
faqs.a: Common signs of storm damage include cracked or missing shingles, dents on metal surfaces, water stains on ceilings, and granule buildup in gutters.

faqs.q: What does a typical roof inspection involve?
faqs.a: A routine roof inspection includes checking for shingle condition, flashing integrity, and gutter functionality and identifying visible signs of damage or wear.

faqs.q: How can I determine if my roof needs to be replaced?
faqs.a: Consult a professional roofer to assess the extent of damage, but factors such as age, significant shingle deterioration, and recurrent leaks may indicate the need for a roof replacement.

faqs.q: How can regular maintenance prolong the lifespan of my roof?
faqs.a: Routine maintenance involves cleaning gutters, trimming overhanging branches, inspecting for shingle damage, and addressing minor issues promptly to extend your roof's lifespan.

faqs.q: Does a free inspection cost me anything or obligate me to anything?
faqs.a: No. Our roof inspections are no fee, no obligation. Our team walks your property, assesses the condition of your roof, and gives you an honest answer — no pressure, no upsell.

about_story: Results Roofing is a licensed roofing construction company headquartered in Carrollton, Texas, serving Dallas–Fort Worth, Houston, Austin, San Antonio, College Station and Temple, with local teams added in Atlanta, GA and Wilmington and Raleigh, NC. Founder and CEO Dustin Gutkowski started the company after dealing with contractors that were less than ethical — the goal was to build the roofing company he wished he'd been able to hire. That shows up in how we work: we're with you at every step, including standing beside you during the inspection and being present with your insurance adjuster. We're GAF Master Elite® President's Club certified, a distinction fewer than 2% of roofing contractors in the country earn, which unlocks GAF's strongest warranties and holds us to the industry's highest workmanship standard. Backed by 1,500+ verified 5-star reviews, we've built our reputation one roof at a time. We're relational, not transactional.
brand_voice_sample: Direct, warm, homeowner-first. Leads with credentials and honesty rather than urgency. Recurring phrases: "We've got you covered — literally", "relational, not transactional", "no pressure, no upsell", "free inspection, no cost, no obligation", "we're with you every step of the way". Insurance-claim advocacy is the emotional center of the brand.
